full_judgment:
2. It has been asserted in the Writ Petition that the Bangladesh Mudran Shilpa Samity in short B.M.S.S is a Trade Organization licensed under the Trade Organization Ordinance 1961, (Ordinance No. XLV of 1961) to function as a Trade Organization of the sector printing and packaging Industry. The Chairman of the executive Committee for the year 2007-2009 made a prayer to the director, Trade Organization, Ministry of Commerce, the Respondent No.1, for extension of the tenure of the executive committee and the respondent No. 1 extended the tenure of the said Executive Committee for 4 months from date, through office memo No. এম/টি/ও/২/এ-১২ dated 18.6.2009, with a direction to arrange the election of the executive committee of BMSS by the extended time. Accordingly, Election Board constituted for the purpose of the election of the said trade organization, declared the two phase election schedule and code of conduct for the aforesaid election on 20.07.2009 fixing 10.10.09 for election of Executive Committee Members in the first phase and fixed 26.08.2009 for filing objection against preliminary voter list. On 25.08.2009 seven persons filed objection against the preliminary voters list. The objection and the prayer was rejected on 29.08.2009 by the Election Board and ultimately final voter list was published on 30.08.2009 according to election schedule. 

 3. On the withdrawal day of the nomination paper on 17.09.2009, the election Board published final candidate list and found only 33 candidates for 33 posts eligible and declared 33 candidates as elected as there was no contestant for any of the posts. The election Board then published 2nd phase of the election schedule for the election of office bearers. Thereafter, on completion of entire election, the election result was finally published on 27.09.2009 and on the same day the result of the election was communicated, to the Director of Trade Organization, Respondent No.2. 

 8. The learned Advocate Mr. Immam Hasan, in support of the Rule Nisi submits that seven persons tiled objection before the election Board on 25.08.2009 after publication of the preliminary voters list and prayed for inclusion of their names in the Voters list. Which were rejected upon an appeal, the Election Appeal Board found that the objectors did not fulfill the requirements of Rules 6 and 13(3) of Trade organization Rule 1994, in short T.0 Rules 1994 and through their order dated 29.08.2009 dismissed the objection. Thereafter, the Election Board published final voters list on 30.08.2009 and proceeded with the election process and the Election Board on 7.09.2009 published the list of candidates and 37 nomination papers from 37 candidates was found valid. After withdrawal of 4 candidates, Election board published on 17.09.2009 final list of candidates and found 33 candidates out of 33 posts valid for election. Accordingly, these candidates have been declared as elected uncontested on 17.09.2009 and the result was published on 27.09.2009. The result of the election was communicated to the Director, Trade Organization respondent No.2. 

 12. Under such facts and circumstances and legal position the learned Advocate Mr. Immam Hasan finally argued that the DTO has acted unreasonably, while issuing the impugned order (Annexure-C) and did not consider the Prevailing facts and circumstances and as such the Rule Nisi may be made absolute and the impugned order may be declared as passed without lawful authority and is of no legal effect.
